name: codex-mod
description: Subagent types codex-mod:codex and project-declared roles answered by the local OpenAI Codex CLI (codex exec) instead of an Anthropic model.

codexPath.title: Codex binary
codexPath.description: Absolute path of the codex executable. Empty: found on PATH, then in common install locations.

defaultModel.title: Default model (codex agent)
defaultModel.description: Model of the generic codex-mod:codex agent. Empty: the first model Codex lists.

defaultEffort.title: Default reasoning effort (codex agent)
defaultEffort.description: Reasoning effort of the generic codex-mod:codex agent; must be one the model supports.

defaultSandbox.title: Default sandbox (codex agent)
defaultSandbox.description: codex exec --sandbox of the generic codex-mod:codex agent.

projectRoles.title: Roles per project
projectRoles.description: Read .claude/codex-mod.json in the session working directory at session start and register its roles besides codex. Off: do not read the file.

modelAgents.title: Agent types per Codex model
modelAgents.description: Register each visible model in models_cache.json as a codex-mod agent type. Hosts that reject slug punctuation use a logged hyphenated alias. Project roles win name collisions.

allowProjectFullAccess.title: Allow project full access
allowProjectFullAccess.description: Allow roles declared by a repository to request the danger-full-access sandbox. Off: refuse those roles.

lean.title: Lean Codex launches
lean.description: Remove optional Codex context and tool families. Multi-agent off also adds an instruction and detects spawns; native v2 tool removal is not guaranteed. Roles can restrict this preset or request user-approved capabilities.

globalRules.title: Load global Codex rules
globalRules.description: Off (experimental): run Codex with a plugin-owned CODEX_HOME that links only auth.json, config.toml and models_cache.json, so the user-level AGENTS.md is not loaded.

extraConfig.title: Extra Codex config
extraConfig.description: Advanced: raw key=value overrides passed as -c to every launch (model, model_reasoning_effort and sandbox_mode are refused).

handbackMode.title: Handback mode
handbackMode.description: How the final answer reaches the caller: auto (SubagentHandback by default; plain text only after the tool answers that it is not active for the agent), tool, or text.

footer.title: Footer
footer.description: The line after each answer: full (agent, model, effort, sandbox, actions, Codex tokens, thread), short (agent, model, effort) or off.

nativeActions.title: Native action rows
nativeActions.description: Show Codex's commands and file changes as Bash/Edit/Write rows (never executed). Off: plain text lines in one step.

richRows.title: Rich rows (experimental)
richRows.description: Draw Codex sub-agent spawns as Agent rows and plan updates as TodoWrite rows when available (otherwise codex_plan), answered by the plugin and never run.

nestedAgents.title: Nested Codex agents
nestedAgents.description: With app-server, observe existing Codex children in real nested host agents without executing them again. Off: retain Batch 5 lifecycle/report rows. Unsupported attachment or host admission falls back with a note.

progressIntervalMs.title: Progress interval (ms)
progressIntervalMs.description: At most one action step per interval (0 to 60000).

maxActionsPerStep.title: Actions per step
maxActionsPerStep.description: The most Codex actions shown in one step (1 to 50).

timeoutMinutes.title: Run timeout (minutes)
timeoutMinutes.description: Stop a Codex run after this many minutes and report codex failed: timeout. 0: no timeout.

maxRunsPerWindow.title: Launch guard (runs per 10 min)
maxRunsPerWindow.description: The most Codex launches per agent in 10 minutes (1 to 100); beyond it the agent hands back codex failed: launch guard tripped. One launch per message, with at most one counted capacity retry.

transport.title: Transport
transport.description: How Codex is run: exec (codex exec --json, the default) or app-server (experimental: a node sidecar drives codex app-server, so a message sent mid-run steers the running turn and a stop interrupts it). app-server falls back to exec when node, the sidecar or codex app-server is unavailable.

nodePath.title: Node binary (app-server)
nodePath.description: Absolute path of the node (18 or later) that runs the app-server sidecar. Empty: found on PATH, then in common install locations.

pruneDays.title: Keep agent records (days)
pruneDays.description: Agent records (thread, model, effort) not used for this many days are deleted (1 to 365).

allowProjectNonLean.title: Allow project rich capabilities
allowProjectNonLean.description: Allow repository roles to request lean=false or expand the lean preset. Explicit user extraConfig still wins. Prefer selective grants for routine research.

projectCapabilityAllowlist.title: Project capability grants
projectCapabilityAllowlist.description: User grants for lean project roles: webSearch:cached, webSearch:live, mcp:<configured-name>, multiAgent, skillsInstructions, apps, plugins, images (image generation). No wildcards.

capacityFallback.title: Capacity fallback models
capacityFallback.description: Ordered fallback candidates validated against models_cache.json. Retry at most once on the same thread after a capacity failure, within the launch guard. Empty disables retries; roles may override with fallbackModels.
